summary: BACKEND-DEV fixed the WF-02 Step 5 release blocker (migration 062 view-dependency) for SPT-02/03/04 on feature/WF02-spt02-04-20260816. Migration 062_remove_tenant_id_rls_from_public.sql now DROPs every public view that depends on a Class-B tenant_id column (v_active_configs from 052, plus any view stacked on it) BEFORE the DROP COLUMN, and RECREATES them AFTER with their original definition semantics minus the removed tenant_id projection. The discovery is a fixpoint (direct column-level dependents then relation-level dependents) and aborts (RAISE EXCEPTION, transactional rollback) if any view OTHER than v_active_configs is found, rather than silently dropping a view with no known recreation. Also hardened the Class-B discovery in both DO blocks to base tables only (relkind='r') so a view can never pollute the _spt_class_b set. Verified end-to-end: zig build exit 0 (no error-set); zig build migrate exit 0 on bpm_test AND bpm_dev (bpm_dev applied 062/063/1163 cleanly over the exact failing state — public.v_active_configs depending on public.artifact_activations.tenant_id); zig build bench exit 0 against bpm_dev (BPM_DB_URL:5442) emitting all 5 NFR_RESULT lines passed=true (p99_read 1.144ms, p99_write 4.146ms, throughput 13236 eps, replay 51ms, snapshot 6ms) with NFR_BENCH_SUMMARY overall_passed=true; test-integration-spt still 16/16 PASS; lint_migration_schema 0 violations (151 files); lint_handoffs exit 0. Post-state on bpm_dev verified: public.artifact_activations has no tenant_id, public.v_active_configs recreated without the tenant_id projection, tenant_default.v_active_configs untouched (keeps tenant_id). No regression test added — TEST-DESIGNER (Step 5 follow-up) will add view-dependency coverage per the release-decision route.

issues_found.description: During implementation I discovered and fixed a secondary defect in the first draft of the 062 fix: the Class-B discovery query populated _spt_class_b from information_schema.columns, which also lists VIEW columns, so v_active_configs itself polluted the Class-B set and the DROP COLUMN loop emitted two confusing 'relation v_active_configs does not exist' NOTICEs. Fixed by joining pg_class and requiring relkind='r' (base tables only) in both discovery blocks. No residual impact; verified the NOTICEs are gone.

Pre-existing, out of scope for this fix (carried from RELEASE-VALIDATOR): GH-812 / ISS-0715 remains OPEN (fix verified in-run, commit 3ec8832e) — closure is DOC-UPDATER's job. bpm_dev half-migrated state has now been resolved by applying 062/063/1163 via migrate.
